name: Copper Top
description: Copper Top is a lively karaoke venue known for its great atmosphere and friendly staff. It offers a vibrant environment with live music and karaoke nights that attract a diverse crowd, including college students and locals. The venue features a good sound system, a decent song selection, and a relaxed vibe. It serves drinks and food, making it a popular spot for casual nights out, celebrations, and karaoke enthusiasts alike.
